Kai OS reads your Apple Mail inbox and Apple Notes so the assistant can answer questions about them. It never changes them.
Kai OS turns your speech into text on this Mac when you hold the talk key.
Kai OS needs access to your contacts to help with replies.
Kai OS needs access to your calendar for proactive suggestions.
Kai OS accesses your calendar events to understand your schedule.
Kai OS accesses your desktop for file-based knowledge.
Kai OS accesses your documents for file-based knowledge.
Kai OS monitors file changes for knowledge updates.
Kai OS uses local network for MCP server and model inference.
Kai OS needs camera access for screen context.
Kai OS needs system access for computer-use automation.
Kai OS needs accessibility access for computer-use automation.
Kai OS listens only while you hold the talk key or the mic button is on.
